A developer's feasibility starts as land cost per buildable square foot. This division is the first line of every pro forma that ever pencilled — or didn't.
Selling a side strip or an easement corridor? Its square footage times the land's per-foot rate is the opening number, before lawyers adjust for everything else.
Appraisals allocate value between land and improvements. Recomputing the land's per-foot figure from their allocation is the reviewer's first sanity check.

$20 per sq ft sounds modest until it meets 43,560 sq ft: $871,200 per acre. Urban per-foot pricing and rural per-acre pricing describe the same reality at scales where each unit stays readable — the calculator keeps both in view.
At $30 per sq ft, a full acre is $1,306,800. A $2-per-foot difference on a 10,000 sq ft lot is $20,000 — per-foot negotiations are worth having precisely because the unit looks small.

popular_table.note: The per-acre column assumes the rate holds across a full acre — in practice larger parcels usually price lower per foot. The table translates units, not market behaviour.

faq: Land only, or land plus house?
This figure prices the land. A listing's total includes buildings; ask for the land allocation (or estimate the improvements' value) before computing a land rate, or you are pricing bricks as dirt.
Why is per-foot pricing rare for farms?
At farm scale the per-foot number collapses to cents — $8,500 an acre is $0.20 per sq ft — and humans negotiate badly in fractions. Units follow the scale of the deal.

Wetlands, easements and setbacks may be unbuildable. Sophisticated buyers compute both rates: per total foot for the deal, per buildable foot for the project. This calculator takes whichever area you give it.
Corner and high-frontage lots command premiums per foot. A single per-foot rate flattens those differences — use it for comparison, then let location specifics speak.
How do I get the lot's square footage?
From the survey or listing, or measure the boundary in the Map Area Calculator — and for a rectangle, length × width in the Lot Size Calculator.

Downtown parcels sometimes trade per square foot of permitted floor area (FAR-based). That is a different denominator — buildable floor space, not land — and worth a clarifying question in any serious negotiation.
Per-square-metre pricing converts at 10.7639 sq ft per m²: $20 per sq ft is about $215 per m². The calculator's equivalents keep the translation visible.
